title: Monthly SEO Plans
meta: A first month of steady SEO work with a clear report on what we did and what changed. Ongoing care is quoted separately. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Monthly SEO plan, first month sprint
overview: This is the start of steady SEO for your store. We set up your tracking, review where you stand, pick the most useful pages to improve and do the first round of work, such as titles, text, a few technical fixes and internal links. At the end you get a short report in plain English that says what we did and what changed in your traffic. Month by month care is quoted separately after that.

faq: No. This is a fixed first sprint with a clear scope and price. If you want us to continue each month, we quote that separately, once we have seen how your store responds.
Will you promise page one rankings?
No. No honest SEO provider can. We do careful work, show you the numbers and explain what the changes mean for your traffic.
Which tools will the report use?
Google Search Console and your analytics, which stay in your accounts. You can open the same figures yourself at any time.
What happens after the first month?
You get a plan for the next three months. You can carry it out with your own team or ask us to continue, with a monthly quote that matches the work.
